description: Source file implementing the TunDeviceController class for managing network interface addresses and routes, specifically for a QBone tunnel device in a QUIC networking context.

classes.name: TunDeviceController
classes.description: Class responsible for managing network interface addresses and routing rules for a tunnel device in a QUIC environment.

methods.name: UpdateAddress
methods.description: Updates the network interface address to a desired range, removing old addresses and setting a new one.

methods.name: UpdateRoutes
methods.description: Updates network routes and routing rules for the device based on desired ranges and routes.

methods.name: UpdateRoutesWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to update routes multiple times with delays between retries.

methods.name: UpdateRules
methods.description: Updates IP rules for the device, replacing default routing rules if enabled.

methods.name: current_address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address assigned to the device.

methods.name: RegisterAddressUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called when the address is updated.
